pairs: Vir erat in terra Hus, nomine Job:
There was a man in the land of Uz named Job,
et erat vir ille simplex, et rectus,
and he was a simple and honest man,
ac timens Deum, et recedens a malo.
fearing God and withdrawing from evil.
And there had been born to him seven sons
Et fuit possessio ejus septem millia ovium,
And his possession was seven thousand sheep,
along with five hundred pairs of oxen
and also a very large family.
eratque vir ille magnus inter omnes orientales.
And this man was great among all the people of the east.
Et ibant filii ejus, et faciebant convivium per domos,
And his sons went and made a feast by houses,
Et mittentes vocabant tres sorores suas, ut comederent et biberent cum eis.
And sending, they called their three sisters to eat and drink with them.
Cumque in orbem transissent dies convivii,
And when the days of their feasting had been completed,
mittebat ad eos Job, et sanctificabat illos:
Job sent to them and sanctified them,
he offered holocausts for each one.
Ne forte peccaverint filii mei, et benedixerint Deo in cordibus suis.
“Perhaps my sons have sinned and have not praised God in their hearts.”
So Job did all the days.
cum venissent filii Dei ut assisterent coram Domino,
when the sons of God came to attend in the presence of the Lord,
And the Lord said to him,
quod non sit ei similis in terra,
For there is no one like him in the land,
fearing God and withdrawing from evil.”
“Does Job fear God to no purpose?
and every one of his belongings around him,
blessed the works of his hands,
et possessio ejus crevit in terra?
and his possession has increased in the land?
But extend your hand a little,
and touch all that he possesses,
and see if he still praises you to your face.”
Therefore, the Lord said to Satan,
Ecce universa quæ habet in manu tua sunt:
“Behold, everything that he has is in your hand,
tantum in eum ne extendas manum tuam.
only do not extend your hand against him.”
Egressusque est Satan a facie Domini.
And Satan departed from the face of the Lord.
Cum autem quadam die filii et filiæ ejus comederent et biberent vinum in domo fratris sui primogeniti,
So, on a certain day, when his sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine, in the house of their first-born brother,
and the donkeys were grazing beside them,
and the Sabeans rushed in and carried away everything,
and they struck the servants with the sword;
et evasi ego solus, ut nuntiarem tibi.
and I alone evaded them to tell you.”
And while he was still speaking,
“The fire of God fell from heaven,
and, having struck the sheep and the servants,
et effugi ego solus, ut nuntiarem tibi.
it consumed them; and I alone escaped to tell you.”
And while he also was still speaking,
but they have struck the servants with the sword;
and I alone fled to tell you.”
Filiis tuis et filiabus vescentibus et bibentibus vinum in domo fratris sui primogeniti,
“Your sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine in the house of their first-born brother,
repente ventus vehemens irruit a regione deserti,
when suddenly a severe wind rushed forth from a region of the desert
and shook the four corners of the house,
and I alone escaped to tell you.”
Tunc surrexit Job, et scidit vestimenta sua:
Then Job got up and tore his garments, and,
et tonso capite corruens in terram,
having shaved his head, he collapsed on the ground,
Nudus egressus sum de utero matris meæ,
“Naked I departed from my mother’s womb,
and the Lord has taken away.
Just as it pleased the Lord,
Blessed be the name of the Lord.”
In omnibus his non peccavit Job labiis suis,
In all this, Job did not sin by his lips,
neque stultum quid contra Deum locutus est.
nor did he speak any foolish thing against God.
